title: HTTPS Only option
body:
This would turn off 4chan X on the HTTP version of 4chan to prevent leaking posting and browsing history to a MITM, and for convenience redirect to HTTPS 4chan. Could be combined with the inverse of `Exempt Archives from Encryption` to cut down 4chan X's ever-expanding number of settings. Would be off by default, but at the top of the settings so it's easy to notice.

Description could be "For increased privacy, use only the HTTPS version of 4chan and the archives."
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
Also we should recommend the setting be used in combination with HTTPS Everywhere.
"Best used with HTTPS Everywhere."

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Meh, I'm just going to make it say "Use only the HTTPS version of 4chan and the archives."

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: On second thought, this ought to be separate from the archive option. But they should be replaced next to each other since they're both encryption related.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Added a "Redirect to HTTPS" option, now on by default.
